primary_unit: one actual-final live-equivalent 32-pose window per sealed clip

window_protocol.required_landmarks: nose, shoulders, hips, knees, ankles, heels, and foot indices
window_protocol.terminal_window: the last chronological 32-pose candidate window in the sealed interval; if that exact window fails the app-equivalent quality gate, the clip is insufficient-quality and no earlier window substitutes for it

primary_metrics: end-to-end decision coverage, conditional clip accuracy, balanced accuracy, per-class recall, confusion matrix, and Wilson 95% interval
source_analysis: Report unique source groups by class and source-group aggregates; repeated/overlapping windows are descriptive only.
rule: Quality review may abstain for wrong-person tracking or unusable framing without consulting classifier scores. Do not tune or retrain on v35.
